landing.faq.brand.a: No. Bills, receipts and statements carry your business's name — and your logo, if you add one — and nothing of ours.
landing.faq.brand.q: Will my customers see YourKhata on my bills?
landing.faq.cost.a: Nothing today. The plans under Pricing are proposed and awaiting approval, every account is free until paid plans are ready, and you do not need a card to sign up. Pricing for other modules will be decided when they launch.
landing.faq.einvoice.a: Not today. YourKhata makes GST tax invoices that you print or share; it does not generate e-invoices on the government portal.
landing.faq.export.a: Yes. Lists export to CSV, and the owner can download all of the business's data from Your data in Settings.
landing.faq.export.q: Can I take my data out?
landing.faq.gst.a: Yes. Add your GSTIN and state once. Each bill splits the tax into CGST and SGST for a customer in your state, or IGST for one in another state, from each item's rate.
landing.faq.gst.q: Does it make GST invoices with CGST, SGST and IGST?
landing.faq.hindi.a: Yes. Every screen is in Hindi and English, and you can switch at any time. Names and notes stay exactly as you typed them.
landing.faq.hindi.q: Can I use it in Hindi?
landing.faq.lending.a: Not yet. Lending & collections is planned, and none of it is built. When it is, it will record what a lender and a borrower agreed and what was collected. It will not lend money, move money or check anyone's credit.
landing.faq.modules.a: Shop & billing: customers and suppliers, money owed, GST invoices, estimates and credit notes, purchases, stock, payments, expenses and reports. Lending & collections, Library, Gym & fitness and Hotel & stays are planned, and cannot be used yet.
landing.faq.modules.q: Which modules can I use today?
landing.faq.phone.a: Yes. YourKhata works in the browser on any phone or computer — Chrome, Safari, Edge or Firefox. There is nothing to install.
landing.faq.phone.q: Does it work on my phone?
landing.faq.staff.a: Yes. Each person gets their own login and a role, so a counter helper can do their work without seeing everything the owner sees.
landing.faq.staff.q: Can my staff use it with limited access?

landing.module.hotel.problem.2: A guest's charges added up by hand at check-out.

landing.module.lending.problem.1: Principal, interest and instalments worked out by hand in a notebook.
landing.module.lending.problem.2: Daily, weekly or monthly collection rounds with no clear list of who is due.
landing.module.lending.problem.3: Disagreements about what was paid, with no dated history to show.
landing.module.lending.purpose: For keeping a clear record of money lent: who borrowed it, what was agreed and what has been collected. It will keep records only. It will not lend or move money.

landing.module.library.purpose: For keeping the catalogue, the members, and every book that goes out and comes back.

landing.uc.bill.alt: A two-item tax invoice with CGST and SGST filled in automatically, then the issued invoice with Share on WhatsApp, Print A4 and Print 80 mm.
landing.uc.bill.benefit: A correct tax invoice with your shop's name on it, in about a minute.
landing.uc.bill.features: Tax invoice · Automatic CGST and SGST · A4 and 80 mm print · WhatsApp share
landing.uc.bill.problem: Working out CGST and SGST by hand is slow and easy to get wrong.
landing.uc.bill.step1: Pick the customer and add two items.
landing.uc.bill.step2: CGST and SGST are split for you from each item's rate.
landing.uc.bill.step3: Issue it, then share on WhatsApp or print on A4 or 80 mm.
landing.uc.khata.alt: The customer list, then Ramesh Traders' page, where a ₹1,200 You gave entry with a note is saved and the balance updates.
landing.uc.khata.benefit: Every rupee has a date, a note and a balance beside it.
landing.uc.khata.features: Customer ledger · You gave and You got · Running balance
landing.uc.khata.problem: Money owed is kept in a notebook, and every balance is added up by hand.
landing.uc.khata.step1: Open the customer from your list — Ramesh Traders.
landing.uc.khata.step2: Tap You gave, enter ₹1,200 and a note.
landing.uc.khata.step3: Save. The balance updates at once, and a ₹500 You got brings it to ₹700.
landing.uc.purchase.alt: A purchase bill with GST and a Paid now amount, then a supplier payment made against that bill.
landing.uc.purchase.benefit: Every supplier balance, bill by bill.
landing.uc.purchase.features: Purchase bills · Input GST · Supplier payments
landing.uc.purchase.problem: Supplier bills pile up, and you lose track of what is still unpaid.
landing.uc.purchase.step1: Enter the supplier's bill with its GST.
landing.uc.purchase.step3: Pay the rest later, against that bill.
landing.uc.reminder.alt: A customer statement, then Send reminder with the WhatsApp message, then the aging buckets.
landing.uc.reminder.benefit: A polite, exact reminder in two taps. You press send.
landing.uc.reminder.problem: Asking for money is awkward, and it is easy to forget who is late.
landing.uc.reminder.step2: Tap Send reminder. WhatsApp opens with the message and amount written in.
landing.uc.reminder.step3: Check aging to see whose balance is oldest.
landing.uc.reports.alt: The Reports hub, then the day book, then the GST summary with output tax, input tax credit and net payable.
landing.uc.reports.benefit: The figures your accountant asks for, already added up.
landing.uc.reports.features: Day book · GST summary · Sales and purchase registers
landing.uc.reports.problem: At the end of the day it is hard to say what came in, what went out and what tax you owe.
landing.uc.reports.step2: Read the day book: everything that happened, in order.
landing.uc.reports.step3: Open the GST summary: output tax, input tax credit and net payable.
landing.uc.stock.alt: The item list, then Adjust stock with the reason Damage and −2, then the Low stock list.
landing.uc.stock.benefit: Know what to reorder before the shelf is empty.
landing.uc.stock.features: Items · Stock adjustments · Stock movements · Low stock
landing.uc.stock.problem: You find out an item has run out when a customer asks for it.
landing.uc.stock.step1: Open Items to see what is in stock.
landing.uc.stock.step2: Adjust stock with a reason — damage, −2.
landing.uc.stock.step3: Open Low stock to see what to reorder.
